screening_decisions.reason: Randomized trial comparing indomethacin (COX inhibitor) vs terbutaline for tocolysis in women with preterm labor at 26-32 weeks gestation. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, COX inhibitor used for tocolysis, women in preterm labor, gestational age within 20-36 weeks.

Observational pharmacokinetic study measuring placental transfer of indomethacin before cordocenteses. Not a randomized trial, and indomethacin was not administered for tocolysis (given before procedures for standard indications). Does not meet selection criteria.
Cochrane review assessing magnesium sulphate for fetal neuroprotection. Wrong intervention (magnesium sulphate, not COX inhibitors). Does not meet selection criteria.

Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial comparing celecoxib (COX-2 selective inhibitor) vs indomethacin (non-selective COX inhibitor) for treatment of preterm labor at 24-34 weeks gestation. Meets all selection criteria and directly addresses the review objective of comparing COX-2 selective vs non-selective inhibitors.

Randomized, double-blind trial comparing sulindac (COX inhibitor) vs terbutaline for management of preterm labor. Gestational age approximately 32 weeks (within 20-36 weeks). Meets all selection criteria.
Cochrane review assessing progestational agents for preterm labor. Wrong intervention (progestational agents, not COX inhibitors). Does not meet selection criteria.
Methodological paper comparing statistical analysis methods for trials including multiple pregnancies. Not a clinical trial of COX inhibitors for tocolysis. Does not meet selection criteria.

Prospective, double-blind randomized trial comparing ritodrine+placebo vs ritodrine+indomethacin for threatened preterm labor. Indomethacin (COX inhibitor) used as part of tocolytic regimen. Meets selection criteria.
Randomized, double-blind, double-dummy trial comparing indomethacin (COX inhibitor) vs nylidrin for imminent preterm labor at 25-34 weeks gestation. Meets all selection criteria.

Matched cohort study (not randomized) comparing neonatal outcomes in infants whose mothers received indomethacin vs those who did not. Selection criteria requires randomized trials only. Does not meet selection criteria.
Methodological paper comparing statistical analysis methods for trials with multiple births. Not a clinical trial of COX inhibitors for tocolysis. Does not meet selection criteria.

Randomized trial of rofecoxib (COX-2 inhibitor) for PREVENTION of preterm delivery in high-risk women (prophylactic use from 16-32 weeks). Selection criteria specifies 'women in labour' for tocolysis, not prophylactic prevention in women not in active labor. Does not meet selection criteria.

Randomized, double-masked trial comparing indomethacin vs placebo for prophylactic tocolysis in women with PPROM at 24-31 6/7 weeks gestation. While prophylactic, this involves COX inhibitor for tocolysis in preterm gestation. Conservative inclusion as it may be relevant to the review.
Randomized trial comparing indomethacin vs sulindac (both COX inhibitors) for treatment of refractory preterm labor at 29-30 weeks gestation. Meets all selection criteria.

Randomized trial of indomethacin vs terbutaline vs placebo, but study population consists of women with LOW-RISK pregnancy and NO SIGNS OF PRETERM LABOR. Selection criteria requires 'women in labour'. Does not meet selection criteria.
Prospective, randomized, double-blind trial comparing indomethacin (COX inhibitor) vs placebo for premature labor. Meets all selection criteria.
Prospective randomized trial comparing ketorolac (COX inhibitor) vs magnesium sulfate for arrest of preterm labor at ≤32 weeks gestation. Meets all selection criteria.
Systematic review and network meta-analysis of tocolytic therapy. Not a primary randomized trial. Does not meet selection criteria.
Cochrane review assessing betamimetics for preterm labor. Wrong intervention (betamimetics, not COX inhibitors). Does not meet selection criteria.
Randomized prospective trial comparing indomethacin (COX inhibitor) vs ritodrine for long-term treatment of preterm labor at 23-34 weeks gestation. Meets all selection criteria.
Study design unclear - abstract describes 'a series of 297 women' without mentioning randomization. Does not appear to be a randomised controlled trial as required by selection criteria.
This is a meta-analysis/systematic review, not a primary randomised trial. Selection criteria require randomised trials only.
This is an in vitro laboratory study using serum-free organ culture, not a clinical trial in pregnant women. Does not meet population or study design criteria.

Randomised double-blind trial comparing mefenamic acid (non-selective COX inhibitor) vs placebo for prevention of premature labour. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, COX inhibitor intervention, women at risk of preterm delivery.
This is a Cochrane systematic review protocol/overview, not a primary randomised trial. Selection criteria require individual randomised trials.
This is an epidemiological review paper describing causes and risk factors of preterm birth. No intervention study, not a randomised trial.
This is a meta-analysis of maintenance tocolytic therapy, not a primary randomised trial. Also focuses on maintenance therapy rather than acute tocolysis with COX inhibitors.

Randomised trial comparing indomethacin (COX inhibitor) vs magnesium sulfate vs nifedipine in women with acute preterm labour (average 28.6 weeks gestation). Meets selection criteria: RCT, COX inhibitor intervention, appropriate gestational age range.
This is a community-based cohort study following up infants born preterm. Not a randomised trial of COX inhibitors for tocolysis. Intervention was antibiotic prophylaxis/placebo, not COX inhibitors.
Randomised trial comparing indomethacin (COX inhibitor) vs magnesium sulfate for preterm labour in pregnancies <32 weeks gestation. Meets all selection criteria.
This is a matched retrospective cohort study, not a randomised trial. Selection criteria require randomised trials only.
This is a Cochrane systematic review of nitric oxide donors, not a primary randomised trial. Also does not focus on COX inhibitors.
This is a literature review discussing use of indomethacin and other PSI in pregnancy. Not a primary randomised trial.
This is an observational population-based database study examining temporal trends in preterm birth. Not a randomised trial of COX inhibitors.

Randomised trial comparing rofecoxib (COX-2 selective inhibitor) vs magnesium sulfate for preterm labour at 22-34 weeks gestation. Meets all selection criteria including the comparison of COX-2 selective vs other tocolytics mentioned in review objectives.
This is a Cochrane systematic review of magnesium sulphate, not a primary randomised trial. Does not focus on COX inhibitors.

Double-blind randomised trial comparing three COX inhibitors (indomethacin, sulindac, nimesulide) for tocolysis in women at 28-32 weeks gestation with preterm contractions. Meets all selection criteria.

Prospective randomised double-blind trial comparing indomethacin (COX inhibitor) vs placebo for premature labour. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, COX inhibitor intervention, appropriate population.
